The harness records backend errors, report failures, and blocked reports as attempts in [delegate.ts](/home/annas/Desktop/repo/agent-router/src/coordinator/delegate.ts:257). Before the ladder, it may resume a stalled Claude delegate once with a nudge, or restart after context overflow if the delegate already made tool calls ([delegate.ts](/home/annas/Desktop/repo/agent-router/src/coordinator/delegate.ts:296)).

Then `nextStep()` applies the ladder, within the configured attempt limit ([escalation.ts](/home/annas/Desktop/repo/agent-router/src/router/escalation.ts:45)):

1. Retry the same provider and tier once with a sharper brief, unless the error calls for skipping retry or the attempt budget favors a later rung ([escalation.ts](/home/annas/Desktop/repo/agent-router/src/router/escalation.ts:82)).
2. Switch to a live fallback at the same tier.
3. Raise the tier; at the top tier, try any remaining live provider.
4. Stop on success, cancellation, blocking, exhausted attempts, or an exhausted ladder.

Tests cover the full retry → fallback → tier-up sequence and key skip-retry cases ([delegate.test.ts](/home/annas/Desktop/repo/agent-router/src/coordinator/__tests__/delegate.test.ts:50), [escalation.test.ts](/home/annas/Desktop/repo/agent-router/src/router/__tests__/escalation.test.ts:12)). One untested edge case: when multiple earlier providers are dead, the tests don’t verify that fallback selection skips all of them and chooses the next live candidate.
